en: Proverbs 20

p.src: 1  Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

en: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
u.src: 1  Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

p.src: 2  The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

en: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
u.src: 2  The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

p.src: 3  It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

en: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.
u.src: 3  It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

p.src: 4  The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
u.src: 4  The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

p.src: 5  Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.
u.src: 5  Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

p.src: 6  Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

en: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
u.src: 6  Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

p.src: 7  A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

en: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
u.src: 7  A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

p.src: 8  A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

en: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
u.src: 8  A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

p.src: 9  Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

en: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?
u.src: 9  Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

p.src: 10  Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

en: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
u.src: 10  Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

p.src: 11  Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

en: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
u.src: 11  Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

p.src: 12  The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.
u.src: 12  The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

p.src: 13  Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

en: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
u.src: 13  Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

p.src: 14  “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

en: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
u.src: 14  “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

p.src: 15  There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

en: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
u.src: 15  There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

p.src: 16  Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

en: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
u.src: 16  Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

p.src: 17  Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

en: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
u.src: 17  Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

p.src: 18  Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

en: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
u.src: 18  Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

p.src: 19  He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

en: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
u.src: 19  He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

p.src: 20  Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

en: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
u.src: 20  Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

p.src: 21  An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

en: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.
u.src: 21  An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

p.src: 22  Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

en: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.
u.src: 22  Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

p.src: 23  The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

en: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
u.src: 23  The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

p.src: 24  A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

en: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?
u.src: 24  A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

p.src: 25  It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

en: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
u.src: 25  It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

p.src: 26  A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

en: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
u.src: 26  A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

p.src: 27  The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

en: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
u.src: 27  The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

p.src: 28  Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

en: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
u.src: 28  Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

p.src: 29  The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

en: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
u.src: 29  The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

p.src: 30  Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

en: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
u.src: 30  Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
